newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's SOMAFIC issues $14.4 mln notes on bourse.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's SOMAFIC issues $14.4 mln notes on bourse.

text.p: Moroccan credit consumer firm SOMAFIC, a subsidiary of BMCI bank, issued 144 million dirhams ($14.4 million) medium term notes on the stock exchange, a bourse official said on Monday.
Subscription was opened from July 10 to August 8, 1997, the official said.
The bills were issued on a three-year maturity term at 9.5 percent interest rate, he added.
One of nine listed credit consumer firms on the bourse, SOMAFIC has no Reuters Identification Code (RIC).
It was last traded at 430 dirhams while BMCI rose at 460 dirhams.
Half-owned by France's Banque Nationale de Paris Intercontinentale, BMCI has recently increased its capital to 742.5 million dirhams from 618.75 million, a broker said.
The bank showed a net profit of 102.5 million dirhams in 1996, up from 61.2 million dirhams in calendar year 1995, the broker added.
